steps.question: How many icon sizes exist?
steps.why: One size next to text, one for decoration.

steps.question: How big are icons next to text?
steps.why: Larger icons hold their own next to big type.

steps.question: What icon style and stroke?
steps.why: Contained icons sit in a tinted shape at a 1.75px stroke, so they carry the brand's warmth.

pick: radius.pill: We use a pill corner for buttons and inputs in order to mark their role as controls in a playful tone, by brand convention. A full radius does this by rounding both ends into a capsule, the brand's signature shape. So every action feels bold and friendly, because the brand is bold (brand.q1), controls are pills (shape.values) and each section holds one big idea (content.q2).
